headline: As of 2026-09-24: 126,893 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 9 of 50 states, D+41.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 126,893 early/mail ballots cast so far across 9 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+41.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (94,284), Wisconsin (13,449), North Carolina (9,424).
